Aspect.description:
Rendered slide dimensions. html slides are 1920x1080, png slides come back
1376x768 (1.792:1, not 16:9), so a player mixing both letterboxes.

AudioOverview.description: What makes a session an audio overview. See docs/audio-overview-spec.md.

focus.description: what the person asked it to centre on; empty when nothing

minutes.description: about how long it was written to run

updated_ms.description: the last time a source or an output was added or changed

title.description: what the person called it; absent or empty and the studio names it from its sources

outputs.description: its decks and audio overviews, newest first; maps and notes are mindmap_list / notes_list on the cid

title.description: trimmed; empty hands the naming back to the studio

CollectionSummary.description: A collection as a list shows it: the record and what is in it.

preparing.description: decks and audio overviews still being made

CostLine.description: One step of a build and what it costs. Every step is listed, free ones too.

detail.description: how the count was reached, in plain words

free.description: runs locally or makes no call

group.description: the phase: reading sources, script, slides, narration

input_tokens.description: measured from the sources and prompts (typical case)

model.description: the model it calls; empty when it calls none

step.description: what the step does, in a few words

unpriced.description: the model has no price in the catalog; counted as 0

via.description: which service makes the call, and through what

Cue.description:
One subtitle-sized span within a line's audio. ALWAYS EMPTY in phase 1 — see
the phase 1 spec section 2. Declared so a later producer is not a schema
change; nothing populates it and no caller should expect content.

DeckRef.description:
Separate from SlideRef because `deck_ref` used to be one with a permanently
empty `slide`, which §4 called out as the same class of lie as a declared
protocol nothing serves — a field that is always empty teaches a reader to
ignore it, and a player addressing the deck by it gets nothing. §2 already
describes this as "collection + presentation".

NarrationLine.description:
`audio_path` is the studio's own local path and it is deliberately NOT what a
player fetches: it is unreachable from a browser and it is an absolute path on
this box. `audio_url` beside it is the route that serves those bytes, and it
is the field a player reads. Both are present because the path is what the
prep job wrote and the url is what the surface exposes; a reader that wants
bytes wants the url.

audio_path.description: studio-local path to the WAV; absent until synthesised

audio_url.description: route that serves that WAV; absent until synthesised

duration_ms.description: measured from the WAV header, never estimated

ordinal.description: explicit; never inferred from position in the list

speaker_id.description: REQUIRED, always, even in a one-speaker session

PlaybackAtReq.description:
The browser sends where it actually is rather than the studio inferring it from
a timer: the audio element is the only clock that knows what was really heard,
and a studio-side timer would drift from it.

Playhead.description:
`offset_ms` is a FREE millisecond value inside `line_id`, not a line index.
§5 requires pause at an arbitrary offset and requires the offset to be
recorded, because phase 2 pauses on a keypress mid-line; a player that can only
stop between lines is one phase 2 rewrites. Building it now is a parameter,
retrofitting it is a rewrite.

Session.description:
`speaker_count` is NOT a field. It is `speakers` length, and a stored count
can disagree with the speakers present — two fields describing one fact.

audio.description: present for an audio overview, which has chapters and no slides

collection_sid.description: unused, kept so older rows decode; a collection is deleted by name

failure.description: reason a "failed" session failed, with its prep job sid

prep_job_sid.description: the job that prepared this session

sid.description: names the session directory and the memory collection too

style.description: the slide style id a deck was built in; absent for an audio overview and older rows. A retry passes it back as `style`.

question.description: what the listener wants to know, in their words

slide_ordinal.description: the slide they were on (0-based), so the answer can start from it

answer.description: a short spoken-style answer grounded in the session's sources

SessionBuildReq.description:
A build from a collection's sources, with the studio's defaults for whatever is not
given. The one call an agent needs after gathering sources.

audio_format.description: make an audio overview instead: "deep_dive", "brief", "critique" or "debate"

collection.description: the collection (cid from collection_create) whose sources to build from

focus.description: what to centre the audio overview on

slide_count.description: how many slides, 3 to 12 (outside is clamped); the studio setting when absent

speakers.description: 1 for one narrator, 2 for a narrator and an expert in conversation; the studio setting when absent

style.description: a style id from styles_list; the studio setting when absent

title.description: the output's title, a few words; absent, the collection's title, or "Narrated slides" / "Audio overview" while it has none

assumptions.description: what was measured, what was estimated, what is not included

limit_usd.description: the studio's spending limit per session; 0 when there is none

minutes.description: about how long the session's narration will run

over_limit.description: the high estimate is over the limit, so a build would be refused

priced_at.description: when the prices were read, RFC 3339

slides_tier.description: the model that writes the slides, e.g. anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5

SessionGetResult.description:
`found` is the discriminator and it is separate from `session` on purpose.
Absence is a missing row, and a caller should never have to infer it from
an empty value: read `found`, never the emptiness of `session`.

found.description: the discriminator; never infer absence from `session`

SessionPinReq.description:
Pinning, both directions. `pinned: false` unpins — not a separate method,
because the button is a toggle and two methods would let the two drift.

SessionPrepareReq.description:
This RETURNS as soon as the job row exists. Preparing a session takes minutes
— 20 to 37 s per slide to render plus 4.4 to 5.7 s per line to synthesise —
so it is a job with progress, never a request anyone waits on. Poll
session_get with the returned sid.

audio_length.description: "shorter" | "default" | "longer"; absent takes the studio setting; a length the format does not offer becomes "default"

focus.description: what to centre the audio overview on, in the person's words

resource_dir.description: directory of user resources to ingest

sid.description: must be unique per workspace: it names the session directory AND the memory collection

slide_count.description: a deck's slides, 3 to 12 (outside is clamped); absent takes the studio setting. Ignored for an audio overview.

speakers.description: empty takes the voices from the studio settings, as session_build does

SessionPrepareResult.description:
What a prepare call returns. `accepted` says the job row was created, NOT that
the session prepared: read the session's `state` for that. Reaching
steps_total does not imply success either.

prep_job_sid.description: the job row the prep runs as

SessionRetitleReq.description:
Renaming. The title is the one thing in a session a person authored, and the
model's guess at it is often wrong in a way only they can fix.

title.description: trimmed; empty is refused rather than stored, since a session with

SessionSlide.description:
`slide_url` is the route that serves this slide's rendered HTML, the same way
`audio_url` serves a line's WAV. The slide bytes are files under the deck
root, not part of this document; this route reads them on the caller's
behalf so a player needs no file access of its own.

title.description: the part's heading: the slide's title, or an audio overview's chapter

SessionSummary.description:
Listing sessions. Summaries rather than whole documents: a session carries
every line of narration and a list of them would be megabytes.

audio_format.description: an audio overview's format id; empty for a session

duration_ms.description: the narration's length, from its measured lines; 0 before it is synthesised

kind.description: "session" for a narrated slide session, "audio" for an audio overview

slide_count.description: slides of a session, chapters of an audio overview

spent_known.description: false for a session prepared before spend was recorded, or not fully priced

SlideRef.description:
Addresses one slide on disk: `<collection>/<presentation>/<slide>` under the
deck root, where `collection` is the session's deck directory.

role.description: free text; phase 1 does not interpret it

voice_id.description: a Kokoro voice id, e.g. af_bella, am_adam

info.description: Narrated slide sessions: build one from gathered sources, follow the build, read, list and manage sessions, ask questions about one, and drive playback.
info.title: SessionService

methods.description: Start a collection: an empty set of sources to add to (see the sources tools, with the cid as sid) and build outputs from. The title is optional.
methods.name: collection_create

methods.description: Every collection, most recently updated first, with counts of its sources and outputs.
methods.name: collection_list

methods.description: One collection and its decks and audio overviews. Check `found` first.
methods.name: collection_get

methods.description: Rename a collection; an empty title lets the studio name it. False when there was no such collection.
methods.name: collection_retitle

methods.description: Pin or unpin a collection. False when there was no such collection.
methods.name: collection_pin

methods.description: Design the collection's cover again now, from what it holds, even if nothing changed. Returns once it is drawn; with covers off in Settings no model is asked. False when there was no such collection.
methods.name: collection_cover_refresh

methods.description: Delete a collection with its sources and everything made from them: its decks and audio overviews as session_delete removes one, its maps and notes. A job still preparing one is stopped. False when there was no such collection.
methods.name: collection_delete

methods.description: Build a narrated slide session or an audio overview from a collection's sources: pass `collection` and an empty sid, and call it as often as you like for more outputs. Takes minutes; poll session_get with the returned sid until state is ready or failed.
methods.name: session_build

methods.description: One session in full: state (preparing, ready, failed), title, slides and every narration line. Check `found` first.
methods.name: session_get

methods.description: Every session, newest first, as summaries (sid, title, state, slide count). Use session_get for the full content.
methods.name: session_list

methods.description: What session_build would cost with the same arguments, before running it: every step, its model, tokens and a low/typical/high price in USD. Makes no model call.
methods.name: session_estimate

methods.description: Ask a question about a built session and get a short answer grounded in its sources.
methods.name: session_ask

methods.description: Low-level build with every parameter explicit (speakers with voices, a resource directory on the server). Prefer session_build.
methods.name: session_prepare

methods.description: Delete a session (a deck or an audio overview): its row, then its deck, audio and memory collection, best effort. A prep still running is stopped. False when there was no such session.
methods.name: session_delete

methods.description: Rename a session. False when there was no such session.
methods.name: session_retitle

methods.description: Pin or unpin a session in the gallery. False when there was no such session.
methods.name: session_pin

methods.description: Where a session's playback is now: slide, line and offset, playing or paused.
methods.name: playback_get

methods.description: Start or resume playback at a position.
methods.name: playback_play

methods.description: Pause playback, recording the exact position.
methods.name: playback_pause

methods.description: For players: report the current position while playing.
methods.name: playback_progress

methods.description: For players: the last line of the last slide has ended.
methods.name: playback_finish
